title: Executive – Data Analyst
description:
**About Us:**

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.

We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND** **RESPONSIBILITIES:**  
**Note:** The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

Junior Data Analyst is responsible for collecting, validating, analyzing, and interpreting data to support business operations and financial performance initiatives. This role serves as a key analytical partner to stakeholders across multiple teams, utilizing advanced Excel, AI tools, and reporting platforms to develop actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong technical analytics capabilities with business acumen and the ability to effectively communicate complex findings to diverse audiences. This position requires a high degree of attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced global environment. This role offers excellent opportunities for professional growth and skill development in data analytics and business intelligence

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Data Analysis & Management**

* Collect, validate, enter, and maintain large datasets from multiple sources while ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
* Utilize advanced Excel functions, AI-assisted analytics, and analytical techniques to identify trends, variances, and business opportunities.
* Conduct data quality reviews and implement corrective actions when inconsistencies are identified.

**Reporting & Business Intelligence**

* Develop, maintain, and automate recurring reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Translate complex data into clear and concise reporting for leadership and key stakeholders.
* Create ad hoc analyses and presentations to support business initiatives and executive decision-making.
* Partner with business leaders to identify reporting needs and recommend meaningful metrics.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Gather business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
* Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders at varying organizational levels.
* Support strategic initiatives through comprehensive data analysis and project participation.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve data management, reporting processes, and analytical methodologies.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and business performance.
* Support system enhancements, reporting automation, and process standardization efforts.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Data Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 2+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, or a related field.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including:
  + Pivot Tables
  + XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP
  + Advanced formulas and functions
  + Data validation and data modeling
  + Power Query and Power Pivot preferred
* Fluent and comfortable using AI tools and applications (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms) to enhance productivity, support analysis, and improve work quality.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large, complex datasets.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a global, matrixed environment.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within healthcare, revenue cycle, or related healthcare environments.
* Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of SQL or other data querying tools preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Analytical Thinking
* Business Acumen
* Financial Analysis
* Data Visualization
* Attention to Detail
* Organizational Skills
* Customer Focus
* Effective Communication
* AI Proficiency & Digital Adaptability

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**  
**Note:** Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions as described. Regular eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity is required to operate office equipment. The ability to perform work at a computer terminal for 6-8 hours a day and function in an environment with constant interruptions is required. At times, Team Members are subject to sitting for prolonged periods. Infrequently, Team Member must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs. Team Member may experience elevated levels of stress during periods of increased activity and with work entailing multiple deadlines.  
A job description is only intended as a guideline and is only part of the Team Member’s function. The company has reviewed this job description to ensure that the essential functions and basic duties have been included. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.

title: Director Data Analytics
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Job Description:**

* As Director, Data Science, this leader will oversee the Payment Integrity Decision Intelligence (PIDI) Data Science and AIML Analytics India team, driving data science and AI-led innovation, analytical excellence and strategic transformation to deliver measurable business value across clinical and non-clinical payment integrity programs through a high-performing team of data science and AIML experts
* The leader will champion a culture of innovation, scientific rigor and continuous improvement while establishing best practices for model development, validation, monitoring, performance optimization and building solid relationships with global analytics and data science teams
* Also responsible for advancing the PI organization's analytical capabilities through the development, refinement and deployment of predictive and prescriptive models that uncover actionable opportunities and generate measurable business value

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Lead Data Science and AIML India team, defining the vision, strategy, priorities and execution roadmap for AI, Machine Learning and Advanced Analytics initiatives that drive payment integrity outcomes and measurable business value across clinical and non-clinical value streams
* Build, mentor and develop a high-performing team of Data Scientists and AIML experts, fostering a culture of innovation, technical excellence, continuous learning, scientific rigor, accountability and business impact
* Provide strategic Data Science and AI leadership, partnering across business, operations, clinical, product and technology organizations to support broader PIDI data science strategy, identify high-value opportunities, influence key decisions and deliver scalable analytical solutions that drive measurable business outcomes
* Drive the end-to-end development and evolution of Payment Integrity data science and AIML capabilities, including predictive and prescriptive models, advanced detection engines and analytical solutions that identify Fraud, Waste, Abuse and Error (FWAE) opportunities, outliers or aberrant billing patterns, overpayments and gaps and leakage opportunities across clinical and non-clinical programs
* Serve as a hands-on technical leader and trusted advisor, providing oversight across the full AIML lifecycle, including problem formulation, data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, governance and continuous improvement
* Establish robust model performance, governance and value realization frameworks, including success metrics, monitoring strategies, financial impact assessment, model validation and optimization processes to ensure sustainable business outcomes and maximize savings opportunities
* Champion the application of advanced analytics and AI methodologies, including machine learning, deep learning, predictive and prescriptive analytics, anomaly detection, simulation and statistical modeling to solve complex healthcare and payment integrity challenges
* Lead applied research, innovation and modernization efforts, continuously evaluating emerging fraud and abuse patterns, next-generation AI technologies and advanced analytical techniques, while translating research and experimentation into scalable, production-ready solutions that enhance detection accuracy, operational efficiency and business performance
* Establish and govern Responsible AI practices, including Data Compliance, AIRB approvals, model risk management, explainability, guardrails and human-in-the-loop oversight to ensure safe, compliant, ethical and business-aligned deployment of AIML solutions
* Stay at the forefront of advancements in Data Science, AIML, Healthcare Analytics and Payment Integrity, identifying opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, strengthen organizational capabilities and drive innovation and
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate (Master's/PhD) degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related quantitative disciplines
* 15+ years of experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, AIML and predictive modeling, with at least 10+ years leading mid-sized, cross-functional teams
* 15+ years of hands-on programming experience using Python, R, SAS, SQL and distributed computing frameworks, in conducting statistical, research-minded analysis of variety of data types/forms with aim to utilize this analysis into building or optimizing predictive methods
* 10+ years of deep, hands-on experience with machine Learning applied to the healthcare or other high-stakes domains (direct experience in a cloud environment is highly valued)
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale AIML solutions from concept through production deployment and business adoption
* Solid experience with cloud-based AIML platforms such as Azure AI, Azure Databricks or equivalent
* Deep expertise in Machine Learning, Statistical Modeling, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Generative AI technologies
* Solid understanding of MLOps, Model Governance, Responsible AI, Model Monitoring and AI Risk Management and AIRB frameworks
* Proven ability to partner with executive leadership and business stakeholders to translate complex business problems into scalable AI solutions
* Proven solid communication, stakeholder management and executive presentation skills with the ability to influence senior leadership decisions

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience leading Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Copilot, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Automation initiatives, ML engineering tools and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph
* Experience with AIML system design, solution architecture, enterprise integration patterns, APIs and microservices-based deployments
* Experience in deploying machine learning models at scale with CI/CD, automated monitoring, observability and model lifecycle management
* Experience leading AI-driven product development, innovation programs and research-to-production initiatives
* Experience in Lean Six Sigma (Green belt/Kaizen)
* Solid knowledge of data platforms and big data technologies including Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric and Hadoop ecosystems

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Analytics & Modeling Analyst - Flood Modeller
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Practical programming experience in Python; familiarity with scientific computing environments, and experience with R, C/C++, Fortran, CUDA, or bash is advantageous
* Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including model training and validation, overfitting, and model evaluation; experience with one or more deep learning models such as LSTMs or CNNs and frameworks such as PyTorch
* Demonstrated interest in ML, flood modelling, environmental systems, geospatial analytics, or related scientific applications
* Knowledge of elevation model refining strategies, such as cleaning of LiDAR data and artefact removal, is advantageous
* Familiarity with large-scale model development projects on HPC environments in Linux is advantageous
* Experience working with geospatial foundation models is advantageous
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use

**Education**

* MSc in GIS, Hydrology, Hydraulics, Coastal and Ocean Engineering, Climate Science, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline

**Responsibilities**

* Join a collaborative scientific team building high-resolution, large-scale hydrologic and hydraulic models and contribute to model components, data pipelines, validation, and research
* Contribute to the development and application of large-scale flood hazard model components, including elevation models and other geospatial input layers, stochastic rainfall, rainfall-runoff processes, hydraulic routing, floodplain inundation, and flood-defence failure mechanisms
* Calibrate and validate model components with a focus on GIS, using observed data, published research, and benchmark datasets, including comparisons between simulated and observed flood extents and depths
* Evaluate model outputs such as flood footprints, hazard metrics, and loss patterns using statistical methods, visualisation, and GIS tools
* Advance flood model input layer preparation, including elevation models, land use data, and remotely sensed data, through research, evaluation, and implementation of novel scientific and computational techniques
* Explore, prototype, and evaluate AI and ML methods for model-development challenges including surrogate modelling, spatial downscaling, feature extraction, anomaly detection, data processing, emulator development, and workflow automation
* Contribute to the development of reproducible scientific workflows, code repositories, and data-processing pipelines using modern software development practices
* Communicate research findings and modelling insights to internal stakeholders, clients, and the broader scientific community
* Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative culture through knowledge sharing, constructive review, and continuous learning

**About the Team**  
Our Model Development team brings together scientists, engineers, and data specialists to build natural catastrophe models for hazards including tropical and extra-tropical storms, winter storms and convective storms, coastal and inland flooding, and tsunamis. The Inland Flood team develops high-resolution, large-scale hydrologic and hydraulic models spanning hazard through loss, combining observations, reanalysis and climate data, numerical and statistical modelling, engineering methods, and data assimilation. As AI and machine learning evolve, we integrate them selectively alongside established physical and statistical approaches to improve model development, data processing, quality assurance, and scientific insight. By joining the team, you will contribute to meaningful scientific work, grow as a GIS specialist or flood modeller, and help advance Moody's position as a global leader in catastrophe risk assessment.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Market Research Analyst
description:
**About the Role:** Attentive AI is a construction technology company building the future of takeoff and estimating software. As we continue to scale our go-to-market motion, our Data Operations function plays a central role in sustaining a high-velocity outbound sales engine. We are seeking a detail-oriented, entry-level Data Analyst to join this team and support a growing roster of 15+ Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) with clean, enriched, and actionable B2B prospect data across the US and Canadian construction market. This role offers direct, measurable impact on pipeline quality and revenue generation from day one.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Prospecting & Data Management

* Source and maintain a high-quality B2B prospecting database targeting general contractors, subcontractors, specialty trades, and material suppliers.
* Use ZoomInfo and Seamless.AI to research, enrich, and verify contact-level and company-level data.
* Perform regular data hygiene tasks including deduplication, validation, and formatting of prospect records.
* Organize and maintain structured spreadsheets and tracking files to support SDR outreach workflows.

Market Research & GTM Support

* Conduct market research to identify new target segments, whitespace opportunities, and construction trade verticals.
* Assist in mapping Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) criteria to sourced prospect lists.
* Support go-to-market strategy execution by preparing segmented and prioritized lead lists aligned to campaign goals.
* Monitor competitor activity and construction market trends to surface relevant intelligence for the sales team.

Reporting & Analysis

* Build and maintain Excel/Google Sheets-based dashboards and reports tracking pipeline coverage, data quality metrics, and SDR outreach performance.
* Identify patterns and trends in lost-deal data, outreach response rates, and ICP match rates.
* Present weekly data readouts to the Senior Data Analyst and sales leadership.

**Requirements:**

Must-Have Skills

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets including formulas, pivot tables, filters, and data formatting.
* Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of ZoomInfo and/or Seamless.AI for prospecting and contact enrichment.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct structured market research and synthesize findings.
* Understanding of B2B sales motions, GTM strategy, and outbound pipeline fundamentals.
* Familiarity with automation tools and the practical application of AI in everyday tasks using AI to work faster and more accurately, with sound judgment on when and how to apply it.

Nice to Have

* Exposure to LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, or RocketReach.
* Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) for data entry and management.
* Basic Python or SQL knowledge for data manipulation and automation (not required but a strong plus).
* Knowledge of the US/Canada construction industry NAICS codes, trade segments, procurement cycles.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 0–1 year of relevant experience in data operations, sales operations, market research, or business analytics.

title: Senior Data Engineering Analyst
description:

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Data Engineering & Pipeline Development
  + Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes supporting batch and streaming workloads
  + Build and optimize data ingestion frameworks using technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, and cloud-native services
  + Integrate data from multiple internal and external source systems while ensuring data quality, consistency, and governance
  + Develop and maintain data orchestration workflows to ensure reliable delivery of business-critical datasets
* Data Architecture & Modeling

  + Implement CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automated deployment practices
  + Optimize infrastructure utilization through right-sizing, auto-scaling, partitioning, clustering, and cost-management strategies
  + Contribute to platform automation and engineering process improvements
* Analytics & AI Enablement
  + Collaborate with Analytics, BI, and Data Science teams to enable reporting, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions
  + Develop feature stores and ML-ready datasets for predictive modeling initiatives
  + Ensure data accessibility, consistency, and reliability for downstream analytical applications
* Documentation & Leadership
  + Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, schemas, and operational procedures
  + Document end-to-end data lineage, governance frameworks, and engineering standards

title: Apprentice, Data Analytics & Business Intelligence
description:
**Apprentice – Data Analytics (CSDD)**

**Overview**

The Apprentice – Data Analytics supports the day-to-day execution of data analytics and reporting activities within the Content and Student Digital Delivery (CSDD) team. Working under the close direction of the Lead Specialist, Data Analytics & Business Intelligence, the role focuses on preparing, cleaning, and analysing data, and supporting the build of dashboards and reports with accuracy, consistency, and a commitment to quality.

This role is designed for individuals who are building their foundational skills in data analytics, demonstrating analytical curiosity, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn. The Apprentice follows established analytical workflows and standard operating procedures (SOPs), maintains accurate data records, and escalates issues promptly within defined channels. Exposure to Python for data manipulation and to AI-driven or automation projects is a core part of this role.

The ideal candidate has up to 1–2 years of relevant experience or equivalent internship exposure. Prior experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or AI/automation project environments is an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Preparation & Analysis**

Collect, clean, and transform data from multiple sources using Python (e.g., pandas) and SQL, following established analytical workflows. Perform exploratory analysis, produce accurate outputs within agreed timelines, and support the wider team during key reporting and delivery cycles.

**Dashboarding & Reporting**

Support the build and maintenance of dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI, Excel, or equivalent tools. Ensure metrics, definitions, and visualisations are accurate, consistent, and aligned with PMO governance standards, and provide timely status updates to the supervisor.

**AI & Automation Project Support**

Contribute to AI and automation initiatives – such as reporting automation, Copilot/agentic pilots, and workflow optimisation – by preparing datasets, testing outputs, documenting results, and supporting proof-of-concept work under guidance. Apply consistent judgement when reviewing AI-generated outputs for accuracy and quality.

**Process Documentation & Record Keeping**

Follow documented analytical workflows and standard operating procedures. Maintain accurate data records, query logs, and version-controlled outputs in SharePoint or designated repositories. Assist in updating Job Aids and process documentation as directed.

**Issue Identification & Escalation**

Identify routine data quality or analytical issues during task execution and escalate promptly to the supervisor with sufficient context for rapid resolution. Distinguish expected data variation from non-routine anomalies that require review.

**Stakeholder Communication**

Communicate analysis status, findings, and workflow updates clearly and consistently to the immediate supervisor. Participate constructively in team check-ins, reviews, and analytics working sessions.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, computing, or analytical discipline (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience.
* Up to 1–2 years of relevant work experience. Candidates with relevant internship or placement experience will be considered.
* Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation and analysis and automation
* Exposure to AI or automation projects – whether academic, internship, or professional – is required.
* Prior exposure to data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or digital operations environments is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear and structured updates to supervisors.
* High attention to detail, analytical diligence, and the ability to manage concurrent priorities within defined timelines.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Analytical thinking: Ability to interpret data, spot patterns and anomalies, and translate findings into clear, accurate outputs.
* AI/automation awareness : Familiarity with AI, machine learning, or automation concepts and a willingness to apply them to reporting and workflow tasks.
* Attention to detail : careful adherence to analytical procedures, governance requirements, and data quality expectations.
* Learning orientation : willingness to absorb new tools, techniques, and domain knowledge quickly and apply them as directed.
* Data tooling comfort : working with data, documentation, and reporting/BI tooling in a structured operational environment.
* Team player with a positive, collaborative approach to reviews, check-ins, and cross-functional working sessions.
* Clear and timely communication of analysis status and issues to supervisors.

**Tools & Systems**

Candidates should have working knowledge of, or a demonstrated willingness to learn, the following:

* Python (basics) – data cleaning, transformation, and analysis
* Querying and extracting data from Looker, Oracle PDH,JIRA
* Power BI / Excel – dashboarding, visualisation, and reporting
* AI & automation tools – Microsoft Copilot Studio, agentic/AI reporting solutions, and workflow automation
* JIRA & Smartsheet – task tracking, workflow management, and operational trackers
* Microsoft Teams, Planner & SharePoint – collaboration, file management, and cross-team communication

**Success Metrics**

Effectiveness at this level is demonstrated by:

* Consistent and accurate completion of assigned analytical tasks within agreed timelines, following established workflows and SOPs.
* Low error rate and minimal rework on data preparation, analysis, and reporting outputs.
* Reliable, accurate dashboards and reports with correct metrics, definitions, and version control.
* Constructive contribution to AI and automation pilots, with well-documented and tested outputs.
* Timely and appropriately contextualised escalation of data quality or analytical issues to the supervisor.
* Positive feedback from the supervisor on reliability, analytical rigour, and attention to detail.
* Constructive participation in team check-ins, reviews, and retrospectives.

*This role sits within the Content and Student Digital Delivery (CSDD) team and reports into the Lead Specialist, Data Analytics & Business Intelligence (Parul Mishra). It works closely with the PMO and Business Support function and cross-functional teams across CSDD.*

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Simon \& Schuster is a global leader in general interest publishing, dedicated to providing the best in fiction and nonfiction for readers of all ages, and in all printed, digital, and audio formats. Its distinguished roster of authors includes many of the world’s most popular and widely recognized writers, and winners of the most prestigious literary honors and awards. It is home to numerous well\-known imprints and divisions such as Simon \& Schuster, Scribner, Atria Books, Gallery Books, Pocket Books, Adams Media, Simon \& Schuster Children’s Publishing and Simon \& Schuster Audio and international companies in Australia, Canada, India, and the United Kingdom, and proudly brings the works of its authors to readers in more than 200 countries and territories. For more information visit our website at www.simonandschuster.com.
  
  

The Role
  
Simon \& Schuster is investing in Data \& Decision Intelligence to build a decision ecosystem in which data, tools, and data\-driven automation are embedded in how work gets done every day \- enabling faster, more informed decisions across the company.
  
We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer to help turn that commitment into trusted, reusable data products across publishing, sales, marketing, finance, and operations. This senior hands\-on role combines analytics engineering, business partnership, and responsible use of AI to deliver governed data models, consistent metrics, and scalable self\-service analytics.
  
What You Will Do
  
* Build trusted data products. Develop scalable transformation pipelines, dimensional models, curated data marts, and reusable datasets for reporting, forecasting, experimentation and AI\-enabled use cases.
* Create consistent metrics. Partner with business leaders to define critical measures and encode consistent business logic so teams work from shared definitions across dashboards, analyses, applications, and AI experiences.
* Engineer for trust. Apply automated testing, documentation, lineage, monitoring, code review, and data\-quality controls; resolve issues at their root cause.
* Enable responsible AI. Use approved AI tools to accelerate delivery, prepare governed data for AI applications, and validate generated outputs for accuracy, explainability and business fit.
* Automate manual processes. Partner with business and operations teams to replace repetitive, data\-intensive workflows with reliable, monitored automation that improves speed, accuracy, control, and employee capacity.
* Modernize analytics. Transition fragmented or legacy reporting into governed data products and self\-service experiences while maintaining business continuity and controlling platform cost.
* Lead through influence. Translate ambiguous questions into practical solutions, communicate recommendations clearly, mentor colleagues, and raise team engineering standards.
* Partner across the enterprise. Work with stakeholders in publishing, sales, marketing, finance, operations, supply chain, and technology, including globally distributed colleagues.
* Drive adoption. Document solutions, explain data products in business language, and coach users to confidently interpret and apply data


What You Bring
  
* 5\+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, BI engineering, or a related data role.
* Advanced SQL, dimensional modeling, and experience with structured and semi\-structured data.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud data platform and transformation framework, such as Snowflake and dbt or comparable technologies.
* Practical Python skills and experience with Git, modular design, testing, code review, CI/CD, and production support.
* Experience defining governed business metrics and delivering analytics through Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable platform.
* Strong business partnership, communication, and problem\-solving, with sound judgment around sensitive data and AI\-assisted tools.
* Experience mentoring colleagues and improving team practices through feedback and shared standards.


Preferred
  
* Experience with semantic layers, observability, metadata, lineage, or data contracts.
* Experience with commercial, supply chain, and marketing analytics
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting and enabling governed self\-service analytics.
* Familiarity with generative AI, or AI\-product evaluation.
* Publishing, media, retail, or consumer\-products experience
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field, or equivalent practical experience.


Will Be Measured
  
* Business teams trust and adopt shared data products and metric definitions.
* Critical pipelines and models are reliable, observable, documented, and cost\-efficient.
* Decision cycles become faster, with less manual reconciliation and duplicate reporting logic.
* Manual processes are reduced through reliable automation with measurable improvements in cycle time, accuracy, controls, and employee capacity.
* AI\-enabled analytics are grounded in governed data and produce explainable, validated results.
* Team engineering standards improve through your technical leadership and mentoring.
